article.story: AMES, Iowa -- — Audi Crooks had 21 points, Alisa Williams scored 12 of her 14 in the second half, and No. 14 Iowa State rolled to a 99-34 victory over Sacred Heart on Sunday afternoon. Reese Beaty had 13 points, Addy Brown scored 12 and Lilly Tauleilei 10 as five Cyclones reached double figures. Iowa State (2-0) went on a 19-3 run in the second quarter to go up 54-17 at the half. Crooks scored the first eight points of the third quarter for The Cyclones, going 3 for 5 from the field and 2 for 2 from the line before being subbing out. Williams shot 5 for 7 from field-goal range and added seven rebounds in the second half. Sacred Heart (0-2) was led by Amelia Wood with six points and four rebounds. The Cyclones won the only other matchup, beating the Pioneers in 2016. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
